role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 影魔无时不在俘获手下的亡魂，力量也无时不在汇聚。每一次出手，每一记精准的阴影，收下人头的同时也让他释放积聚灵魂产生的夺命冲击更具威力。
hero_summary_en: Capturing souls from every kill he makes, Shadow Fiend is always gathering his power. Every assault, each carefully aimed raze that kills an enemy, brings him closer to unleashing his gathered souls in a deadly blast of scouring energy.

abilities.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
abilities.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

facet_text_en: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
facet_text_zh: 对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

abilities.name: nevermore_frenzy
abilities.description_zh:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。
abilities.description_en:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

abilities.name: nevermore_dark_lord
abilities.description_zh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。
notes_en: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
facet_text_en: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.
facet_text_zh: 在附近敌方英雄阵亡后魔王降临的降低护甲效果将会暂时提升。

abilities.name: nevermore_requiem
abilities.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

abilities.name: nevermore_necromastery
abilities.description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facet_text_en: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
facet_text_zh: 每次击杀英雄会使灵魂上限增加%max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill%个，直到影魔阵亡。

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_soul_collection_per_hero} Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero
